preamble:
The library itself depends only on the C++ standard library. Catch2 builds the tests. The
Rust crates listed after it are the dependency tree of the separate benchmark program in
bench/rust-comparison, which compares this library with the Rust crates; they are not part of the
library, and their license texts are in each crate (cargo metadata lists them). The benchmark
program depends on oramacore_fields and oramacore_lib, which are AGPL-3.0: a built benchmark binary is
covered by that license.
